items.description:
Designer Water has produced premium pH10+ alkaline ionised water since 2013, bottling it in Midrand from 2015 with added calcium, magnesium and potassium for a smooth, everyday-drinking taste. The brand holds SANBWA certification for bottled-water quality and ISO 22000 certification for food safety management, and distributes through outlets and a reseller network across Gauteng, including the Pretoria area.

Customers can choose larger cases for home use or individual bottles to take along, with free collection or courier delivery available per order. The brand points to its own 2025 taste survey, in which 378 of 390 non-customer participants preferred Designer Water over their usual water in a sighted comparison. Designer Water serves households and resellers across Gauteng looking for a certified, locally produced alkaline water brand rather than an imported bottled-water option.

Dinnerbox is a South African frozen meal delivery service based in Samrand Business Park, Centurion, offering pre-cooked meals ordered through its website or mobile app and delivered nationwide. Its meal range is organised into Everyday, Low Carb, Vegan, Vegetarian, Kids, Family, Dessert and Snack boxes, giving customers a dedicated category for most common dietary needs rather than a single generic menu.

Through its Build-A-Box service, customers can skip the pre-set boxes entirely and pick at least 10 individual meals of their own choosing to build a custom box from scratch. Dinnerbox also runs DinnerDosh, a loyalty-style rewards feature tied to orders placed through the app. Based in Centurion, the service suits households across South Africa wanting ready-cooked meals delivered to the door without the planning and shopping that home cooking usually requires.

DistriFoods operates a branch at the N4 Gateway Business Park in The Willows, supplying commercial catering equipment alongside bulk food and beverage products to restaurants, hotels, healthcare facilities and educational institutions across South Africa. The business positions its offering around a wide product selection, optimised supply chain logistics and consistent inventory accuracy, aiming to keep orders moving smoothly for caterers who depend on regular, reliable deliveries.

Its account management is handled directly by trained staff rather than an automated order system, with the company citing internal figures of around 98% on-time delivery, 95% product availability and 99% customer satisfaction across its operations. Based at the N4 Gateway Business Park in The Willows, Pretoria, DistriFoods serves catering and hospitality businesses needing both equipment and bulk food supply from a single, dependable local distributor.

Divine Landscapes has specialised in the supply and export of large specimen plants and trees since 1996, working from Leeuwfontein Estate on the edge of Pretoria. Its range centres on big trees, baobab trees and palm trees supplied to the landscaping industry and to plant lovers both locally and abroad, alongside contract growing for clients who need specific trees raised to order.

The business also offers turnkey landscaping services, taking a project from tree selection through to a completed, planted landscape. Beyond individual tree sales, Divine Landscapes exports high-quality tree saplings to clients outside South Africa, extending its reach past the local landscaping market. Based in Leeuwfontein Estate, Pretoria, the company serves landscapers, developers and private plant collectors needing large, established specimen trees rather than young nursery stock.

items.description:
Doppio Zero Irene Village Mall is a branch of the Doppio Zero casual dining chain, trading from Shop 132 in Irene Village Mall, Centurion. The branch cooks from a wood-fired oven, serving Italian-style breakfasts, mains, kids' meals and grazing platters in a casual, family-friendly setting typical of the wider Doppio Zero group.

As part of a chain with branches across Gauteng and beyond, the Irene Village Mall restaurant benefits from a shared menu and brand standard while still operating as its own branch with its own reservations line. Trading Monday to Saturday from 7am to 10pm and Sundays from 7am to 9pm, the restaurant suits families and groups in Irene Farm Villages and the wider Centurion area looking for a casual, oven-fired Italian meal without travelling into central Pretoria.

Dotflow is a software and business solutions company based in Boardwalk Manor, Pretoria, building process automation, business intelligence tools and custom software for clients in sectors including financial services, insurance, construction and manufacturing. Its process automation work covers customer relationship management, supply chain management, financial processes and human resources, mapping and streamlining workflows to cut down on manual tasks.

On the business intelligence side, Dotflow centralises client data and visualises key metrics across sales and marketing analytics, operational efficiency, financial analysis and customer insights, giving management a single view of performance. Its custom software work extends into business process management, employee productivity tools, AI-integrated solutions and enterprise resource planning. Based in Boardwalk Manor, Pretoria, Dotflow serves businesses across several industries wanting software tailored to their existing structures rather than an off-the-shelf system.

items.description:
Eco Construction Group is a Sinoville-based building construction and logistics company that holds Level 1 BBBEE status, working with clients across a full end-to-end project process from planning through to completion. Its core services span building and civil construction, long and short-distance haulage and plant hire, asphalt paving for residential and commercial clients, and site planning for project setup from inception onward.

The company also offers professional project management and support services, including reporting and stakeholder engagement, alongside commercial and residential landscape design once building work is complete. Eco Construction Group frames its approach around transparency as a core value in how it deals with clients. Based in Sinoville, Pretoria, with a further base in Brits, North West, the company serves clients needing construction, logistics and site planning handled by one contractor across a project's full lifecycle.

items.description:
EE Compliance Management Services (EECMS) is a Hazeldean-based firm providing nationwide Employment Equity compliance solutions, guiding clients through full procedural compliance with the Employment Equity Act. The firm runs an online solution that begins with a free initial consultation, after which clients deal with EECMS through virtual platforms rather than needing to attend in person for every step of the process.

Its services include an EE calculator and EE quotation tool, formal EE training, and access to supporting documents such as a confirmatory notice and webinar recordings, giving clients practical tools alongside direct consulting. EECMS says it has supported clients through Director General reviews and understands what the Department of Employment and Labour expects in terms of gradual transformation. Based in Hazeldean, Pretoria, the firm serves businesses across South Africa needing Employment Equity compliance managed remotely rather than through an in-house specialist.

Elegance Events & Decor is an East Lynne-based event rental company supplying decor, furniture, catering equipment, tents and jumping castles for functions across Gauteng. Its rental range covers linen such as chair covers, tablecloths, table runners and napkins, alongside catering equipment including harvest boards, crockery, glassware, cutlery and chafing dishes, giving clients most of what a function needs from one supplier.

Customers hire online by browsing the catalogue, selecting items and a delivery date, with the company handling delivery and collection for an affordable fee within a 120km radius; items can also be collected in person. Alongside rental, Elegance now offers its own poolside venue for functions. Trading Monday to Friday from 8am to 5pm and Saturdays until 1pm, the company serves event planners and private hosts across Gauteng who need decor and equipment hired rather than bought outright.

Enabling Solutions (Pty) Ltd is a systems-integration and ICT company founded over a decade ago and based on Jean Avenue in Die Hoewes, Centurion, providing fibre and wireless access, high-speed internet, hosting and cloud voice services. The company holds ISO 9001:2015 certification, giving clients a formal quality-management standard behind the services it delivers rather than an informal guarantee.

Enabling Solutions has built long, value-based relationships with clients through various phases of their business growth, working through strategic partnerships and a team of skilled personnel to deliver cost-effective, value-based ICT solutions. The company positions itself around becoming its clients' preferred technology partner, aiming to turn technology into a competitive advantage rather than just a utility cost. Based in Die Hoewes, Centurion, Enabling Solutions serves businesses across the region needing connectivity, hosting and cloud voice services from an established, ISO-certified provider.

Enterprise Solvents is a manufacturer and distributor of chemical solvents based in Mooiplaats, Pretoria, supplying pure and blended chemicals including ethanol, methanol, acetone, thinners and isopropyl alcohol to customers across Southern Africa. Its range includes specific blends such as 95E5 (95% ethanol with 5% ethyl acetate), 70% fully denatured ethanol blended with water, and IPA blends combining 85% or 70% isopropyl alcohol with ethanol or distilled water.

The business also produces Fragrasol, a range of perfumer's-grade alcohol bases used to create fragrance blends, alongside white spirits for industrial customers. Enterprise Solvents sells both through an online shop and via bulk orders for larger industrial or cosmetic customers, backing its range with product support from its own specialists and scalable supply capacity. Based in Mooiplaats, Pretoria, the company serves industrial and cosmetic manufacturers across Southern Africa needing solvents in either small or bulk quantities.

Enterprise Solvents manufactures and distributes chemical solvents from its Pretoria base, supplying industrial and cosmetic customers across Southern Africa with products such as ethanol, methanol, acetone, thinners, white spirits and isopropyl alcohol. Customers can order ready-blended products, including 95E5 ethanol and ethyl acetate blends, denatured ethanol diluted with water, and IPA blends combining isopropyl alcohol with ethanol or distilled water at set concentrations.

The company also produces Fragrasol perfumer's-grade alcohol for fragrance makers, and sells through an online shop alongside bulk-order supply for larger customers. Enterprise Solvents says it focuses on consistent quality across its range, backed by in-house product specialists who advise on the right solvent for a given application, and a supply capacity able to scale from small retail orders to large industrial volumes. The company serves customers across Southern Africa from its Pretoria operation.

EnvironMist designs, manufactures and installs high-pressure fogging and misting systems from its premises in Donkerhoek, serving applications such as restaurant cooling, agricultural humidity control, odour control and dust suppression. Its system produces fog at up to 70 BAR through precision nozzles, breaking water into droplets under 5 microns in diameter, giving an efficient fog using comparatively little energy and water.

The company's patented stainless steel nozzle line, with a 360-degree orientating collar tested beyond 100 BAR, has reduced installation times and set its systems apart from competing designs, according to the company. EnvironMist supplies risers in single to five-hole configurations across several sizes, and builds systems both on-site and in bulk for import to other businesses. Based in Donkerhoek, the company serves agricultural, hospitality and industrial clients needing custom-engineered fogging or misting systems rather than an off-the-shelf unit.

Etali Engineering and Projects CC is a privately owned engineering workshop in Koedoespoort Industrial, founded in 2007 and now employing around 25 people across its well-equipped facility. The company's services span conventional and CNC machining, casting machining, and repair and maintenance on plant machinery and foundry equipment, alongside the manufacture of pipes and couplings and steel casting boxes to client specifications.

Its welding work covers specialised CO2, TIG, stainless and stick welding, while its equipment list includes a hydraulic press, plasma cutting, laser cutting and spark eroding machinery, letting it develop prototypes and new components in-house. Etali also designs and machines new components across various fields rather than only reproducing existing parts. Based in Koedoespoort Industrial, Pretoria, the workshop serves industrial clients needing machining, welding or equipment repair handled by a single engineering team.

items.description:
Fidelity ADT Pretoria is a branch of the national private-security company Fidelity ADT, operating from the Brooklyn Mall Office Tower in Muckleneuk and providing alarm monitoring, armed response and electronic security installation and maintenance. Beyond home and business security, the group's wider offering includes SecureFire fire and life-safety systems, SecureEnergy backup power solutions such as lithium and gel power packs, and a dedicated vehicle security and tracking service.

Its smart technology range covers CCTV and access control products, including SecureGate, SecureGuard and the FidelitySecure app, alongside a separate Fidelity Cleaning Services division for commercial and residential clients. Fidelity ADT also runs emergency contact lines staffed around the clock for both coastal and inland regions. From its Brooklyn Mall office in Muckleneuk, Pretoria, Fidelity ADT serves homes and businesses across the city needing security monitoring and response backed by a national brand.

Fieldhouse Attorneys is a boutique law practice in Die Wilgers offering conveyancing, notarial and general legal services from a small team that gives clients personal attention rather than being passed between departments. Its service list covers general and prenuptial contracts, business contracts, divorce cases, and the setting up and managing of trusts, alongside tenancy and property law and broader family law matters.

Clients can pay for consultations online through the firm's payments page before a meeting, and the practice offers consultations into the evenings and on Saturdays for clients who cannot get away from work during the day. Fieldhouse positions customer satisfaction as its priority, aiming to keep the legal process straightforward for clients dealing with contracts, family matters or property transactions. Based in Die Wilgers, Pretoria, the firm serves individuals and small businesses needing accessible, personally handled legal advice.

Finpro Accountants is an accounting and tax practice in Theresapark, Pretoria North, established in 2000 and registered with the South African Institute of Professional Accountants. The practice provides bookkeeping, payroll, income tax returns, CIPC annual returns, independent reviews, Pastel accounting support and BBBEE consulting to small and medium businesses and individuals across South Africa.

Finpro quotes its fees upfront based on the work to be completed, with a monthly package option aimed at keeping its professional service affordable for smaller clients, and says it keeps client administration confidential throughout. As a small, dedicated team, the practice aims for clients to deal with the same people consistently rather than a rotating point of contact. Trading Monday to Thursday from 8am to 4pm and Fridays from 7am to 3pm, Finpro serves businesses and individuals across Pretoria North needing accounting and tax support from a SAIPA-registered practice.

Flash Technologies, trading as Flashtech, is a managed IT services provider in Brummeria established in 1999, now drawing on 25 years of experience supporting micro, small and medium enterprises. The company is a Microsoft Silver Cloud Certified partner and a registered partner of Dell, HP, Lenovo, Adobe and Bitdefender, offering hardware and software sales alongside IT support agreements covering remote and on-site assistance.

Its connectivity services span fibre, wireless and LTE internet, VOIP telephony, and website and email hosting, while its Microsoft 365 subscriptions give clients business-class email and cloud services. Flashtech also runs a web design, e-commerce and graphic design division with full-time developers building CMS-based, responsive websites. Based in Brummeria, Pretoria, and also serving Cape Town, Flashtech serves small and medium businesses wanting hardware, connectivity and web services handled by one certified IT partner.

Fluxcon (Pty) Ltd, based at The Willows Office Park in Die Wilgers, is a mobile satellite communications provider reselling Iridium and Inmarsat voice and data solutions for business, government and remote applications across Africa. As an Iridium Tier 1 Service Partner, the company supplies specific Iridium hardware including the Iridium 9555, Iridium Extreme and Iridium GO!, alongside Inmarsat's BGAN and IsatPhone 2 products for customers needing satellite connectivity beyond normal cellular coverage.

Fluxcon also resells Thuraya's range, including the Thuraya One, Thuraya XT and Thuraya XT-Lite handsets, and offers VSAT as a genuine end-to-end satellite data service without needing to coordinate multiple separate providers. The company frames its value around a sizeable distribution network and partnership strength built up over its years in the industry. Based in Die Wilgers, Pretoria, Fluxcon serves clients across Africa needing reliable voice and data connectivity in locations outside normal network coverage.

items.description:
Freeflow Business and Life Coach offers neuroscience-based life and business coaching from The Wilds Estate in Pretoria East, helping clients rethink their values, goals and career direction. Its core neuro-coaching programme runs over six in-person or virtual sessions, working through a client's own story, assessments and goal-setting before processing the specific triggers holding them back from reaching their goals.

Alongside this core programme, Freeflow offers career and development coaching built around aligning a client's values and strengths through applicable assessments, as well as TRE-based stress release work aimed at clients recovering from burnout. The practice takes an approach that is not one-size-fits-all, working from wherever each client is at rather than a fixed process. Based in Pretoria East, Freeflow draws on internationally registered coaching credentials built over decades of corporate business-development experience to support clients through career and personal transitions.

Fresh Farm Deli is a family-run neighbourhood deli and coffee stop in Elardus Park, serving farm-fresh breakfasts, freshly prepared lunches and take-home meals built around quality local ingredients. Its deli counter stocks fresh produce and deli treats alongside biltong and droewors, giving customers a stop for everyday fresh food as well as proper coffee and a quick breakfast or light meal.

The business also runs an online store for customers who want to order ahead or buy deli products without visiting in person. Fresh Farm Deli positions itself around simple, honest food made with care rather than an elaborate menu, aiming to be a warm, welcoming spot where regulars feel at home. Based in Elardus Park, Pretoria, the deli serves locals wanting a dependable neighbourhood spot for breakfast, lunch or deli shopping.

Gala Storage provides secure, brick-and-mortar self-storage units for household goods, caravans and vehicles at the corner of Griffiths Road and Cura Avenue in Equestria, Pretoria East. The facility has been professionally run by the same staff for more than 15 years, and has recently added two further wings to keep up with growing demand for storage space in the area.

Units are rented month to month with no lock-in contract, giving customers the flexibility to store for as long as they need rather than committing to a fixed term. Round-the-clock security is in place throughout the facility, and its Equestria location is easily accessible from both the N4 highway and Hans Strydom Avenue. Based in Equestria, Gala Storage serves households and vehicle owners across Pretoria East needing flexible, secured self-storage close to major routes.

Gary Pettit Surveys is a registered land-surveying practice based at Wapadrand Centre in Pretoria East, providing boundary and cadastral surveys for conveyancing attorneys, estate agents, architects, developers and homeowners. The practice has been delivering professional land surveying services since 1992, giving it more than three decades of experience establishing and confirming exact property boundaries ahead of transfers, subdivisions and disputes.

Beyond cadastral work, the practice prepares sectional title plans for Deeds Office registration, carries out topographical and photogrammetric surveys for planning and design decisions, and provides engineering surveys supporting construction and infrastructure projects. New-build site surveys give architects the site and boundary data they need before design work can start. Based in Wapadrand, Pretoria East, the practice serves property professionals and homeowners needing accurate, registered survey data, with particular experience in sectional-title developments on rural properties.

Gemini Gate and Garage Door Automation Systems supplies and installs GEMINI-brand electronic gate and garage door motors from Silvertondale, Pretoria, under parent company DMI Engineering, which has designed and manufactured the GEMINI range since 1987. The motors offer remote-controlled gate opening, a pedestrian access facility, obstruction and infra-red sensing, and an adjustable auto-close feature, built for both commercial and residential sites.

The business backs its products with free GEMLINK smart-app training and online product guidance, alongside a dedicated repair service for customers having trouble with an existing motor. Independent installers are also available for customers needing on-site fitting rather than a DIY installation. Trading from Silvertondale, Pretoria, and open weekdays from 7:30am to 4:45pm, Gemini serves homeowners and businesses across the city needing gate or garage automation installed, repaired or upgraded.

items.description:
Gerik Plasticus is a plastics manufacturer established in 2010 in Waltloo, Pretoria, custom-producing packaging products such as shrink wrap, plastic sheeting, pallet wrap and tubing to a client's required size, colour and type. Rather than selling only standard pre-cut stock, the business works from each customer's own packaging requirements, aiming to solve problems such as finding the right pallet wrap size to stop goods shifting in transit or sourcing an uncommon tubing diameter.

The company distributes locally across Pretoria from its Mark Street premises, giving nearby businesses a shorter supply chain than ordering from a larger national packaging supplier. Trading Monday to Friday from 9am to 5pm, Gerik Plasticus serves manufacturers, logistics operators and retailers across the city needing custom plastic packaging produced to their own specifications rather than generic off-the-shelf sizes.

GIC - Gap Infrastructure Corporation is an infrastructure developer based in Highveld, Centurion, founded in 2009 and working on town planning, civil services, road works and transportation, and structural development projects. Its work includes the formalisation of informal settlements, alongside property management and mining-related infrastructure work, giving the company a spread across both social and commercial infrastructure development.

The company positions its delivery model around three principles: governance through innovative, tech-enabled oversight; implementation through trusted, locally driven execution delivered on time; and compliance that de-risks delivery for its public and private partners. GIC describes itself as a design, build and finance infrastructure developer working across Africa, bridging public and private sector partnerships to deliver projects. Based in Highveld, Centurion, the company serves government and private partners needing infrastructure designed, built and financed as a single package.

Giftwrap Trading is a Pretoria East wholesaler of corporate gifts, promotional items and corporate clothing, supplying branded products for teams, clients and events across South Africa since 1999. Its catalogue runs to more than 15,000 products organised into categories including gift sets, drinkware, bags, tech gifts, apparel, stationery, and display and events material, alongside golf shirts, jackets, caps, uniforms and workwear for corporate clothing orders.

Alongside product supply, Giftwrap offers corporate identity design, brand strategy and express branding services turned around within 24 to 48 hours, letting clients brand merchandise quickly ahead of a campaign or event deadline. The company supports both once-off campaigns and larger bulk corporate rollouts, with nationwide delivery and bulk quote support available. Based in Persequor, Pretoria East, Giftwrap Trading serves businesses across South Africa needing branded merchandise sourced, designed and delivered from a single supplier.

GlobalTrade Customs (Pty) Ltd is a licensed customs brokerage firm based in Die Hoewes, Centurion, providing customs clearing and cargo-inspection management services for individuals and businesses importing or exporting goods. Its work covers SARS customs entries, HS code and valuation compliance, and duty and VAT facilitation, helping shipments move through South African borders accurately and without unnecessary delay.

The firm's coverage extends beyond South Africa into the wider SACU and SADC regions, handling everything from commercial cargo and export shipments to personal effects brought into the country. GlobalTrade Customs offers fast response times for urgent shipments, aiming to reduce the costly delays that can arise at busy border posts. Based in Centurion, the firm serves businesses and individuals across Southern Africa needing customs clearance handled by a dedicated, SARS-compliant broker rather than managing the process themselves.

items.description:
Grounded at Echo is a coffee shop, deli and coworking space in Villieria, founded in 2014 as a community cafe in partnership with ECHO Youth Development, a local non-profit, with a portion of its profits supporting youth-upliftment programmes in the area. Based in The Moot neighbourhood of Tshwane, the business has since expanded from its original cafe concept into a wider operation offering coworking space and catering services for events, meetings and private functions.

Customers can also stock up through its deli range or shop online, and the venue accepts recyclable waste drop-offs as part of its broader community and sustainability focus. Grounded at Echo hosts a range of public and private events, from meetups and workshops to parties and business gatherings, with rental space available at both its Echo site and its separate Grounded Work location. Based in Villieria, Pretoria, it serves customers wanting a socially conscious coffee shop, workspace or events venue in one place.

Henchem Gauteng is the Gauteng branch of a pest control and vegetation management company with 22 years of experience in the public health pest control and vegetation management markets, based in Hennopspark, Centurion. Its public health pest control work covers crawling and flying insects, rodents, termites, birds and stored-product pests, using specialised chemicals, natural products, application equipment and personal protective equipment supplied alongside its services.

On the vegetation management side, the branch handles turf grass management, industrial weed control, invader plant control, horticultural sites, aquatic environments, bush control and crop protection, drawing on knowledge of plant growth cycles to plan long-term, lower-chemical management programmes. The company also provides accredited training, on-site assessments and hygiene and disinfection services to its clients. Based in Hennopspark, Centurion, Henchem Gauteng serves commercial, agricultural and residential clients across the province needing pest and vegetation management from a single specialist provider.

Hino Tshwane is a Hino truck dealership operating since 1988 on Visagie Street in Pretoria, selling the Hino 200, 300, 500 and 700 series trucks and buses to commercial and fleet customers. The dealership forms part of Motus, Southern Africa's largest and leading automotive group, which operates across import and distribution, retail and rental, mobility solutions and aftermarket parts.

Its service centre carries out brake testing, wheel alignment and fleet servicing, supporting customers who need their trucks kept roadworthy and compliant rather than buying new vehicles only. Being part of a large, listed automotive group gives the dealership access to group-wide parts supply and workshop standards that a smaller independent truck dealer would not have. Based in Pretoria, Hino Tshwane serves transport operators and fleet owners across the region needing new Hino trucks, buses or ongoing servicing support.

Hitech Consulting is a security, solar and electrical installation company based in Florauna, Pretoria North, covering 12 service lines from a single site visit. Its security offering includes CCTV cameras and NVR systems, access control, gate and garage motors, boom gates, alarm systems and network and WiFi installation, letting one contractor handle a property's full security and connectivity setup.

On the power and utilities side, the company installs solar power systems, solar streetlights, solar geysers and borehole solar pumps, along with air conditioning and electrical work carried out with a Certificate of Compliance. Hitech Consulting offers free site quotes, running an on-site survey before recommending specific products for a property's gate, perimeter and power needs. Based in Florauna, Pretoria North, the company serves residential, business and complex clients across the area wanting security, solar and electrical work handled by one contractor instead of several specialists.

HKB Performance and Service Centre is an automotive workshop in Daspoort offering minor and major services on all major vehicle brands, with technicians specifically qualified on Ford and Mazda. Beyond routine servicing, the workshop runs its own dyno tuning service, letting it test and fine-tune a vehicle's performance on-site rather than referring that work out to a separate specialist.

The business has built a loyal following in the Daspoort and Hermanstad area, keeping customers updated on workshop news and offers through its social media page. Combining brand-specific technician training with in-house dyno tuning gives HKB a service range that spans both everyday maintenance and more specialised performance work under one roof. Based in Daspoort, Pretoria, the workshop serves vehicle owners across the city needing anything from a standard service to dyno-based performance tuning.

Hofman Projects is a construction company in De Wilgers founded in 2018 to deliver design-focused construction with the same precision architects put into their own drawings. The company's roots trace back through a family history in the built environment, including a construction business started in South Africa in 1968, and parents who worked as practising architects, shaping an approach built around honouring an architect's design intent while keeping a project on time and within budget.

Its specialisation covers upmarket residential renovations and additions, new builds, and commercial and office fit-outs, with particular expertise in concrete staircases, steel structures and frameless glass installations. Hofman Projects positions itself as a partner in the creative process rather than only an executor of someone else's drawings, built on values of integrity, quality, transparency and collaboration. Based in De Wilgers, Pretoria, the company serves clients undertaking heritage renovations, modern new builds or commercial fit-outs.

ideali (Pty) Ltd is a technology infrastructure company in Willow Park Manor delivering turnkey networking, CCTV and access control, fibre and satellite connectivity, solar and UPS power systems, and fleet telematics for clients in mining, agriculture, hospitality and transport. Its networking work includes enterprise-grade WiFi for large properties and remote operations, alongside guest WiFi and hotspot systems that let businesses offer connectivity while gathering customer insight for targeted advertising.

On the vehicle side, the company supplies vehicle WiFi systems, video, tracking and telematics, plus GSM signal boosters for sites with poor cellular coverage. ideali also offers smart NFC business cards, structured network cabling and connected office containers, extending its infrastructure work into less conventional formats. The company manages projects end to end, from planning and design through to installation and ongoing support. Based in Willow Park Manor, Pretoria, ideali serves demanding, remote and industrial sites across Southern Africa.

items.description:
Inyanga Steel Products, established in 2003, manufactures a comprehensive range of steel case goods and furniture from its Rosslyn facility, with its early focus on stationery cupboards, filing cabinets and lockers. The business has since grown into a fully fledged steel furniture manufacturer, extending its range to beds and divans, canteen bench units, steel kitchen cupboards, work benches, wardrobes, wire lockers and school furniture.

Alongside its steel range, the company also supplies plastic chairs, giving institutional and commercial customers a broader seating option alongside its metal furniture lines. Inyanga Steel Products exports part of its range to markets including Namibia, extending its manufacturing base beyond the domestic market. Based in Rosslyn, Pretoria, the company serves schools, offices and institutions across Southern Africa needing durable steel furniture manufactured locally rather than imported.

IOX Fleet is a software company offering a fleet management platform that unites traffic fine management, vehicle licence renewals, registrations and related payments in one system, based in Elardus Park, Pretoria. Its operational transactions layer uses a secure wallet system to handle payments, allocations and transaction tracking automatically, with direct integrations into municipal traffic systems giving fleet and private vehicle owners daily updates on fine status nationwide.

A structural management layer connects vehicles, drivers, documents and financial records into a single framework, turning scattered records into a clearer operational picture for fleet managers. Its legal and risk layer tracks legislative updates and escalation workflows so that compliance risk stays visible rather than hidden in paperwork. Based in Elardus Park, Pretoria, IOX Fleet serves fleet operators and private vehicle owners wanting fines, licensing and compliance managed from one platform instead of several separate systems.

iRender cc is an official SketchUp Gold Reseller in South Africa with more than 25 years of experience and over 1,400 licences deployed, selling and supporting SketchUp software for architects, interior designers, landscape architects and construction professionals. The company handles local ZAR invoicing on annual subscriptions, letting clients pay by EFT or credit card without dealing with a foreign billing currency.

Its range spans an entry-level, web-based tier suited to hobbyists and light use through to a full desktop Pro edition with layout documentation tools, extension warehouse integration and Trimble Connect collaboration, alongside further Studio and advanced workflow tiers for larger practices. iRender also offers a free seven-day trial so customers can test the software before committing to a subscription. Based in Amberfield, Centurion, and trading since 2001, the company serves design and construction professionals across South Africa needing SketchUp licensed and supported locally.

Jeanelle Granite is a granite and stone supplier in East Lynne, established on 23 January 2006 with an original focus on fabricating and installing kitchen units and built-in cupboards. The business opened a dedicated granite division in 2009, and as its focus on stone grew, moved to working solely with granite, quartz and marble surfaces for kitchen tops and cupboards.

Its engineered quartz range includes well-known brands such as Caesarstone, Pro Quartz and Eezi Quartz, while its granite and marble are sourced both locally and from countries including Israel, Brazil, India, Turkey and Namibia. Services cover on-site measure-ups, cut-outs for new or replacement appliances, and full fabrication and installation of finished surfaces. Based in East Lynne, Pretoria, Jeanelle Granite serves homeowners and renovators needing granite, quartz, marble or porcelain countertops cut, polished and installed from a single local workshop.

Jetline Montana is a printing and graphic design store at Montana Crossing Shopping Centre, offering full-colour and black and white printing, corporate stationery, document duplication and binding, banners, signage, vehicle branding and website design. As part of the wider Jetline Print network, the Montana store also handles books and publishing work, calendars and planners, and courier services for finished print jobs that need to reach a client elsewhere.

Its range extends into packaging and labelling, personal printing, photographic products, and promotional events and gifting, alongside retail and exhibition displays and safety products such as signage required under workplace regulations. Trading Monday to Friday from 8am to 5pm and Saturdays from 9am to 1pm, Jetline Montana serves businesses and individuals across the Montana area needing anything from a single printed document to a full exhibition display produced locally.
